# Third-party material shipped in this folder

| Name | Version | Source URL | Licence | Licence text |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| three.js (core module build and the addons OrbitControls, LineSegments2, LineSegmentsGeometry, LineMaterial) | 0.160.0 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/ (npm package `three`, https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js) | MIT | `three/LICENSE` |
| Newsreader (roman and italic, weights as used) | Google Fonts v26 | https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Newsreader ; files from https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/newsreader/ | SIL Open Font License 1.1 | `fonts/OFL-newsreader.txt` |
| Hanken Grotesk (weights 400, 500, 600) | Google Fonts v12 | https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Hanken+Grotesk ; files from https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/hankengrotesk/ | SIL Open Font License 1.1 | `fonts/OFL-hankengrotesk.txt` |
| IBM Plex Mono (weights 400, 500) | Google Fonts v20 | https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=IBM+Plex+Mono ; files from https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/ibmplexmono/ | SIL Open Font License 1.1 | `fonts/OFL-ibmplexmono.txt` |

Font licence texts were fetched from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/google/fonts@main/ofl/<family>/OFL.txt.
`fonts/fonts.css` is the stylesheet Google Fonts returned for a browser that accepts woff2 (all unicode-range subsets), with the file URLs rewritten to local relative paths.
Everything under `vendor/` is unmodified third-party code and font files, apart from that URL rewrite.
